approve.increase-allowance.title: Increase {symbol} spending limit
approve.increase-allowance.warning: This adds to the spending limit you already granted. It does not replace it. The spender can move up to this much of your tokens at any time.
approve.native-value.warning: This approval also sends {amount} {symbol} to the token contract. Approving a token never requires sending {symbol}. Only continue if you fully trust this website.
approve.unlimited.warning: This grants an unlimited spending limit. The spender can move all of this token from your wallet at any time, including tokens you receive later.
approve.excessive-limit.warning: This spending limit is far above your balance. The spender can move that much of this token at any time, including tokens you receive later.
approve.native-value.title: Transfer
approve.native-value.unreadable: This request asks to send an amount Trust Wallet can't read, so it can't be approved.
approve.token-details-unavailable: Couldn't load this token's details. Check that the token exists on the selected network, then try again.
send-tx.set-approval-for-all-warning: This grants the operator below permission to transfer ALL NFTs you own in this collection. Only approve if you fully trust this site.
send-tx.set-approval-for-all-revoke: This revokes an operator’s permission to transfer NFTs in this collection.
swap.price-moved: The price moved while preparing this swap. Refresh the quote and try again.
swap.failed-after-approval: The approval went through, but the swap could not be sent. Nothing was swapped. The approval stays in place, so the next attempt will not ask for it again.
swap.not-enough-for-network-fee: Not enough {symbol} to cover network fee
swap.errors.amount_too_small: Amount is below the minimum required
swap.max-below-network-fee: Balance is too low to cover network fees
swap.geoblocked-error: This token is restricted for the country of your residence
swap.unsupported-pair-error: These two tokens can’t be swapped with each other. Try another pair.
send.bridge.title: Bridge & send
swap.error-load-description: We couldn’t load tokens. Please check your connection and try again.
swap.partial-load-description: Some token details couldn’t be updated.
settings-modal.solana-tooltip: Control how fast your transactions will land. Turbo costs more SOL, but will also be faster.
settings-modal.unlimited-allowance-toolt: Approve a token once and swap any amount later. Off is safer: each swap approves only the amount it spends.
swap.high-slippage-warning: High slippage tolerance — your transaction may be front-run and you could receive significantly less.
swap.high-price-impact-warning: This trade has a high price impact of {priceImpact}%. You may receive significantly less than expected.
swap.moderate-price-impact-warning: This trade has a price impact of {priceImpact}%. You may receive less than expected.
swap.quote-timeout-error: Quote request timed out. Please try again.
swap.quote-fetch-failed: Couldn’t fetch a quote. Please try again.
swap.staging-insufficient-balance: Your balance can't cover this amount plus network fees. Reduce the amount and try again.
swap.us-citizen-rwa-error: US citizens are not allowed to swap RWA tokens
swap.restrict-only-usdc-pair-info: You can only pair USDC with this asset
swap.title: Swap
swap.domains-stale: Couldn’t refresh supported networks. Showing recent availability.
